perks.name: To the Pain

perks.name: Firing Line

perks.name: Search Party

notes: pandapaxxy (PvE / M+KB / Controller): "Mechabre has always been a great sniper rifle. Even though High-Impact snipers aren't high meta their high single shot damage is great for solo play or short damage phases where accuracy isn't as important. Triple Tap or Clown Cartridge will get you better ammo with Appended Mag and a backup mag mod. If you're going to be with fireteam members, Firing Line is best in slot. Vorpal Weapon is second best but better for solo or dual fireteams." Recommended MW: Reload Speed.

pandapaxxy (PvP / M+KB / Controller): "Over in PvP you've got two different Ros to go for with combinations between them. The tried and true Snapshot Sights / Opening Shot will always work, especially good if you didn't get the free roll from Festival of the Lost past. Lone Wolf and Closing Time is the new hotness and works best with a mag boosting perk or backup mag to get 2 attempts with Closing Time (versus one shot with the base magazine of 3)." Recommended MW: Handling.

Adamsdown_Boy written v8.1.0.4 (PvE PvE-Boss PvE-MajorSpec PvE-EndGame PvE-God M+KB Controller): First-choice PvE pick for burst damage against Major Spec enemies in end-game content, particularly for arc builds. Mechabre (it's so obviously a Transformers pun on Macabre, so let's just pronounce it Mech-ah-bruh) is reportedly excellent in PvP, but like all aggressive snipers it struggles to find a role in PvE. One thing you could do is use it to apply jolt to beefier targets at a distance. At base, Handling of 26 equates to 0.44s ready speed, 0.45s ADS speed and 0.39s stow speed, and Reload Speed of 30 is a 3.20s reload. With 0/1/2/3 reserve mods, you'll have total ammo of 22/24/26/26 of a max total ammo of 27. As with most snipers, look for a handling-boosting barrel perk. Building towards the end, Flared Magwell gives the biggest boost to reload speed out of the magazine perks, with Tactical Mag a decent alternative. Keep Away in the first trait column as the support perk boosts reload speed by a further 30, as well as boosting range and accuracy all of which, with a reload Masterwork, can get the reload speed up to 85. Alternatively, Air Trigger can boost Reload Speed by the same +30 when you start the reload animation off the ground, and boosts total ammo by the equivalent of 1.5 reserves mods (2 when enhanced). Get one kill against an add, reload and then Voltshot in the second column as the signature perk can apply Jolt to your next target from a safe distance for burst and AoE damage, and to synergise with arc fragments. The Search Party origin trait is more PvP-orientated, but faster ADS speed is always nice to have. Recommended MW: Reload Speed, with a Backup Mag mod or, when masterworked, Synergy to generate Ionic Traces or Stunloader when there's a matching artifact mod.

Adamsdown_Boy written v8.1.0.4 (PvE PvE-Boss PvE-BossSpec PvE-EndGame PvE-God M+KB Controller): First-choice PvE pick for sustained damage against Boss enemies in end-game content. Mechabre (it's so obviously a Transformers pun on Macabre, so let's just pronounce it Mech-ah-bruh) is reportedly excellent in PvP, but like all aggressive snipers it struggles to find a role in PvE. At base, Handling of 26 equates to 0.44s ready speed, 0.45s ADS speed and 0.39s stow speed, and Reload Speed of 30 is a 3.20s reload. With 0/1/2/3 reserve mods, you'll have total ammo of 22/24/26/26 of a max total ammo of 27. As with most snipers, look for a handling-boosting barrel perk, and then Appended Mag with a Backup Mag mod gets you to the maximum of 5 in the mag. If you don't have a well-rolled rapid-fire sniper for backup boss damage, you could start in the first trait perk slot with one of Triple Tap (7 crits before reload), Clown Cartridge (6-8 shots before reload), or Air Trigger to boost Reload Speed by +30 when you start the reload animation off the ground and boost total ammo by the equivalent of 1.5 reserves mods (2 when enhanced). Combine one of those with Firing Line for a ×1.2 damage boost in a fireteam or Vorpal Weapon for a flat ×1.15 boost to majors and bosses in the second. The Search Party origin trait is more PvP-orientated, but faster ADS speed is always nice to have. Recommended MW: Reload Speed, with a Backup Mag mod.

pandapaxxy (PvE / M+KB / Controller): "In order to, in my humble opinion, get the most out of it in PvE, you'll want a base of 4 in your magazine. This way with Clown Cartridge there's a very high chance you'll be with 5 going into engagements. With Vorpal Weapon you won't need to hit crits in order to do good damage and you can take this solo without any drop in damage. Reload MW helps speed up those reloads getting you back to 4 or higher." Recommended MW: Reload.

pandapaxxy (PvP / M+KB / Controller): "Eva spoiled us last year and gave us a god roll, snapshot and opening shot, right off the rip. This year she might not be so giving. If you're looking for max handling, fluted and a handling MW will get you there. You can also opt for Smallbore / Accurized Rounds / Range MW for max range. I am a little sour that Slickdraw was removed, especially after the buff." Recommended MW: Handling.

SirStallion_ (PvE / M+KB / Controller): "AJ is going to be confusing [...] I run a lot of high grenade regen builds, because of this I feel fairly comfortable relying on a damage boost like AJ on a weapon like Mechabre. It may not be as consistent as Vorpal, and it probably won't be the ideal for long boss phases, but for eliminating minibosses and champions, this will be my go to. Throwing an arcbolt to jolt the big guy and kill some trash mobs, giving me a damage boost and a pulse AOE around the target.. nice. Throwing a void grenade to debuff the target, killing some trash mobs, giving me the damage boost.. nice. Throwing a solar grenade, applying more damage to the target, killing some trash mobs, giving me a damage boost.. Nice. You get it. I doubt it would be anyone's first pick, but it is mine." Recommended MW: Reload.

SirStallion_ (PvP / M+KB / Controller): "It's a PvP sniper rifle in Destiny. Of COURSE you want snapshot/opening shot. You want to hit the headshots as quickly and cleanly as you can, this is the combo that will do that for you, it is tried and true. However, if you're a sniper that likes to find tricky lanes and make people say "Wha.. from THERE?" and maybe you don't mind a little extra ADS time, I'd give Keep Away a shot." Recommended MW: Handling.

Clegmir (PvE / M+KB / Controller): "[...] in their current state it is challenging to suggest any sniper for use in PvE content. With Triple Tap generating ammo out of thin air, it is almost mandatory, and Vorpal is a nice “always on” damage perk to pair with it." Recommended MW: Reload.

Clegmir (PvP / M+KB / Controller): "For PvP, if you didn’t score the Snapshot/Opening Shot last go-around, you do have another chance at getting one! You also have the options of getting one with Keep Away and Discord as options. Ammo being refunded on takedowns is a very nice reward to deal with the potential lack of special ammo drops." Recommended MW: Range.

Inspired by DMB PvE Podcast 37. PvE first-choice roll for burst damage against Majors. The Origin Trait, gaining better ADS and strafe speed when on your own, might be useful when you're away from your fireteam, but think of it more as a useful added extra when it's procced. Direct competitor to Occluded Finality, but with a much more reasonable 45 Zoom. You don't really need to worry about range, so look no further than Fluted Barrel to boost Handling and Stability. It's difficult to get to five in the mag to make Triple Tap proc twice, so go for Appended Mag instead to add an extra round, or Flared Magwell for Reload Speed and Stability boosts. In the first trait column, Auto-Loading Holster lets you swap to another weapon to keep DPS up, and in the second column, Vorpal Weapon adds 15% damage against Majors, Bosses and vehicles. Recommended MW: Handling, with a damage-boosting (Major or Taken Spec) mod. Tags: PvE, PvE-Boss, PvE-God, PvE-MajorSpec, PvE-EndGame, Controller, MKB

Inspired by DMB Podcast 280 with @ImpetusAlways. First-choice PvP pick for duelling. The Origin Trait is aimed more at 3v3 game modes, where you're less likely to be near a team mate to gain the better ADS and strafe speed - this should help with sniping too. For snipers you generally want to boost Handling with the barrel. In the mag, there's not an awful lot to help out, but Alloy Mag is probably your best pick to help with reloads after you've emptied the mag. For most people Snapshot Sights and Opening Shot is the best trait combination, getting you into the very reasonable ADS zoom of 45 quickly, adds 20 Aim Assistance and boosts accuracy. Recommended MW: Handling, with a Quick Access Sling, Sprint Grip or Targeting Adjuster mod depending on your preference.

The Origin Trait is aimed more at 3v3 game modes, where you're less likely to be near a team mate to gain the better ADS and strafe speed - this should help with sniping too. For snipers you generally want to boost Handling with the barrel. For an Airborne Effectiveness build, Extended Mag adds 10, Auto-Loading Holster bypasses the reload speed penalty and Opening Shot adds 20 Aim Assistance and boosts accuracy. You will probably need some additional help from an exotic to really make this useful, but it's an option. Recommended MW: Handling, with a Targeting Adjuster or Quick Access Sling mod depending on your preference.
